title: JavaScript: Promises
description: Write a JavaScript program that creates and chains Promises with async/await.
verificationTest: output.includes('Fetching user 1...') && output.includes('Got user 1') && output.includes('Name: User1') && output.includes('Results: User2, User3') && output.includes('Done')
hints: Use `new Promise((resolve, reject) => {})` to create promises
`await` pauses execution until a promise settles
`Promise.all([...])` waits for all promises to resolve
